case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
title: Estimate Exceeds Hard Credit Budget
tests: Checks that an over-budget estimate produces a clear budget warning and no generation, rather than an unauthorized cheaper substitute.

must_haves.item: The response states that the 90-credit estimate exceeds the 30-credit budget.
must_haves.why: The agent explicitly states that the 90-credit estimate exceeds the 30-credit hard limit.

must_haves.item: The response clearly says generation has not started.
must_haves.why: The agent says, “I haven’t started any generation.”

must_haves.item: No clip or substitute asset is delivered.
must_haves.why: The transcript contains only a text response, with no asset delivered or generation run.

reply.summary: The agent meets all three must-haves by acknowledging the budget overrun, confirming generation has not started, and delivering no asset.
